title: Subjective Evaluation Profile Analysis of Science Fiction Short Stories and Its Critical-Theoretical Significance

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multiple LLMs to evaluate science fiction short stories on a 100-point scale across four literary criteria using minimal role descriptors, and then applying Principal Component Analysis (PCA), clustering, and TF-IDF text mining to uncover the models' implicit aesthetic preferences and subjective evaluation patterns shaped by RLHF.
